groups.label: Night bus
groups.source: chosen: Noctilien blue (a Noctilien stop shows a blue sign with an N, ratp.fr/noctiliens via a search extract), approximate; idfm.zip gives the 59 N routes 21 different route_colors; labelled 'Night bus' (the batch's English word for every night network: London, Paris, Berlin, Vienna); the brand is Noctilien, the Paris night network
